incident.observed: The first ideas add acquired the writer flock and appended before returning output; retrying while the first process was still rebuilding the derived index appended the same design again.
incident.mechanism: add_idea holds writer() across read, ideas.jsonl write, and build_index(). build_index rebuilds the SQLite index synchronously over the full assembled registry. The lock file is persistent and zero-byte; its existence is not a stale-lock signal. No progress or completion output is emitted until build_index returns.
prevention: Treat a running add process as potentially committed once its target title appears in ideas.jsonl; do not retry from silence.
Use one serial add process and wait for its JSON result; inspect the targeted title/ID before any retry.
If interruption is necessary, inspect ideas.jsonl first and preserve any assigned ID; do not infer lock state from writer.lock file presence.
incident.scope_limit: No infrastructure or CLI edits made; this is a read-only diagnosis from the actual code and process state.
